test_VectorizedCUSUMDetector_multi_colum: test the VectorizedCUSUMDetector class to detect change points across multiple columns in a single call
review_CUSUMDetector_interest_window: review the CUSUMDetector detector method with interest_window and magnitude_quantile parameters to filter change points
